title: KestrelCare Cancellations: Day from Which Plan Use Is Counted
content:
**Definition.** For the time measure of a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts pro rata refund, the day from which the plan's use is counted is set as follows:

- for a plan sold with the vehicle whose handover date on the purchase order is later than the plan's sale date, use is counted from that handover date;
- for a plan bought after the vehicle was handed over, use is counted from the plan's coverage start date;
- for a plan sold with the vehicle and handed over on its sale date, use is counted from the sale date.

The handover date is the one on the vehicle's Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order; whether the plan was sold with the vehicle, its sale date and its coverage start date are on the plan record. This day sets only where the use begins; the length of the term is unchanged.

| Plan record | Purchase order handover date | Use counted from |
|---|---|---|
| sold with the vehicle | later than the plan's sale date | the handover date |
| sold with the vehicle | the plan's sale date | the sale date |
| bought after the vehicle sale | — | the coverage start date |

*Hypothetical plans:* a plan signed with the purchase agreement on 3 June for a vehicle handed over on 11 June counts use from 11 June. A plan bought on 20 July for a vehicle handed over on 1 July, with a coverage start date of 19 August, counts use from 19 August.
